verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs show that it sends payouts from your available balance to your bank account, and that you can view payouts and their expected deposit dates in the Dashboard. Its reporting can also generate payouts and balance report runs as downloadable CSVs, which points toward reconciliation. However, nothing in the pack documents controlling the payout schedule or breaking each payout down into its charges, fees, and refunds. missing for 10: documented payout schedule controls (daily/weekly/monthly or manual), explicit per-payout itemization of charges, fees, and refunds, independent or hands-on corroboration of reconciliation

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout

citations.quote: Stripe sends funds from your available balance to your bank account as payouts
Track a payout: View your payouts and their expected deposit dates in the Dashboard.
creates report runs for reports such as balance, payouts, activity, tax, and Revenue Recognition. Report runs generate downloadable CSV files.
